observed.bootHelp:
OVERVIEW: Boot a simulator

USAGE: triton sim boot <udid> [--wait] [--jsonl] [--timeout <timeout>] [--interval <interval>] [--json] [--format <format>]

ARGUMENTS:
  <udid>                  Simulator UDID

OPTIONS:
  --wait                  Wait until the simulator reports Booted
  --jsonl                 Emit compact JSON lines while waiting
  --timeout <timeout>     Timeout in seconds when --wait is set (default: 60.0)
  --interval <interval>   Polling interval in seconds when --wait is set
                          (default: 1.0)
  --json                  Alias for --format json
  --format <format>       Output format: text or json (default: json)
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.
observed.tapHelp:
OVERVIEW: Tap a UI target by text, coordinate, oid, or AX node

Explicit --platform ios uses host AX accessibilityPerformPress by default,
including coordinate taps. Pure coordinates with an explicit Simulator selector
and no --platform use host HID. --hid-only forces the local iOS Simulator
coordinate HID path without AX or embedded fallback; all acknowledgements
require business-state verification.

USAGE: triton act tap [<options>] [<query>]

ARGUMENTS:
  <query>                 Text, label, identifier, or visible option title to
                          tap

OPTIONS:
  --selection <selection> Selection id returned by inspect selection; requires
                          revision and runtime instance
  --selection-revision <selection-revision>
                          Positive revision returned by inspect selection
  --runtime-instance-id <runtime-instance-id>
                          Runtime instance returned by inspect selection
  --text <text>           Alternate flag form for the text query; use either
                          positional <query> or --text
  --platform <platform>   Host platform adapter: ios, android, or harmony
  --target, --device <target>
                          Runtime target id or host selector; without
                          --platform, pure coordinates with sim:<udid>, a raw
                          Simulator UUID, booted, or current use built-in HID.
                          Explicit --platform ios defaults to AX; add
                          --hid-only to require HID. --device is an alias
                          (default: triton:local)
  --adb <adb>             Path to adb executable (default: adb)
  --hdc <hdc>             Path to hdc executable (default: hdc)
  --host <host>           Server host (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --port <port>           Server port (default: 19421)
  --format <format>       Output format: text or json (default: json)
  --json                  Alias for --format json
  --x <x>                 Window x coordinate in points
  --y <y>                 Window y coordinate in points
  --oid <oid>             View oid from `triton debug nodes`
  --ax-oid <ax-oid>       AX target/view oid from `triton debug ax`
  --ax-label <ax-label>   Exact AX label to tap by AX target/view oid
  --width <width>         Optional screen/window width in points
  --height <height>       Optional screen/window height in points
  --duration <duration>   Unsupported for tap: press-and-hold returns a typed
                          error without dispatch
  --strategy <strategy>   Activation strategy for query or AX text matches:
                          smart, exact, or ancestor
  --allow-host-hid-fallback
                          Explicitly allow an auditable iOS Simulator host-HID
                          coordinate fallback after embedded
                          UICollectionViewCell activation is rejected
  --hid-only              Force a pure iOS Simulator coordinate HID tap;
                          requires --platform ios or an explicit Simulator
                          selector, rejects semantic/WebView/embedded options,
                          and never dispatches AX
  --index <index>         Select one matching query candidate by 1-based index
  --within <within>       Restrict query matching to bounds: x,y,width,height
  --at <at>               Coordinate selector or query disambiguation point: x,y
  --webview-aware         Route this tap through the current WebView provider;
                          first slice is explicit opt-in
  --selector <selector>   CSS selector for --webview-aware WebView tap
  --webview-id <webview-id>
                          WebView candidate id for --webview-aware tap
                          disambiguation
  --page-session-id <page-session-id>
                          Expected WebView page session id for --webview-aware
                          tap
  --expect-text <expect-text>
                          Expected WebView text after --webview-aware dispatch
  --timeout <timeout>     Timeout in seconds for --webview-aware expectation
                          (default: 3.0)
  --lease <lease>         Target lease token from `triton target lease
                          acquire`; mutating actions fail with
                          target_lease_conflict when another flow holds the
                          lease
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.
